data.raw_text:
MAHALAGANG ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA

Pansamantalang isinara ang isang lane sa southbound ng Mindanao Avenue malapit sa Tandang Sora Avenue ngayong araw. 

Ito ay dahil sa concrete pouring na isinasagawa sa lugar na bahagi ng konstruksyon ng Tandang Sora station ng Metro Manila Subway Project (MMSP). 

Inaasahang matatapos ang aktibidad bukas ng hapon, October 5, 2025 (Linggo). 

Pinapayuhan ang mga motorista na dumaan sa mga alternatibong ruta. 

Nakaantabay naman ang mga tauhan ng Quezon City Traffic and Transport Management Department (QC-TTMD) at MMDA para umalalay sa daloy ng trapiko sa nasabing kalsada.

Maraming salamat po sa inyong pang-unawa.

Morning Everyone!

Just burned through another epic grind on @AnichessGame  and it's evolving into something straight out of a fever dream picture the timeless chess grind colliding with arcane chaos, where your knight doesn't just leap, it warps reality with a spell-slinging twist, pulling from a mana pool that builds turn by turn (up to 8 if you hold back the fury) to unleash game-breakers like board-flipping tempests or enemy piece hijacks, all while the clock ticks on those blistering PvP duels. 

We've clocked over 500k matches and 3M minutes of pure tension since the alpha dropped last October, spiking to 100k MAUs by December's end, with a 40k-strong Discord hive mind churning out lore like the Checkmate Genesis series that weaves real players into Mystra's divine saga of creation versus unraveling shadows. 

Animoca's $3.3M war chest (that fresh $1.8M seed from Sfermion and Amber Group) fused with https://t.co/teZ8sg1pxg's 200M+ legion and Magnus Carlsen's god-tier exhibit matches back in March has this beast primed for Esports World Cup 2025's chess debut, while YGG's SEA distribution pact is flooding onboarding for tournaments like the $10K Bybit Blitz and that Manila finals showdown. 

Kaito's IDO allocation just hit wallets at 1.3x oversub for $35M FDV, but the real juice? $CHECK TGE locked for Oct 25th (mark your calendars, Checktober's here), dripping 56% straight to the community with Ethernals NFT holders snagging priority staking yields, exclusive Orb mints (those NFT powerhouses like time-bending queens), and governance clout over the Sandbox user-crafted spells and rules that could redefine the meta. 

From my endless sessions, the progression system's a trap: even bot routs or ranked slips funnel M8 points for wallet-direct airdrops, tutorials melt the barrier for noobs, and post-match recaps dissect your fumbles like a grandmaster roast, blending depth with that addictive "one more game" hook. 

Polygon's low-gas backbone keeps it seamless, free-to-play entry lures the masses, but CHECK's the ignition for verifiable ownership in a $10B gaming surge staking for yields, in-game asset flips, and DAO votes that hand the reins to us degens. 

With Abstract Chain migrations teasing on-chain PvP purity and Anish Giri's strategic whispers guiding the lore, this isn't just chess 2.0; it's the web3 pivot swallowing traditional esports whole, eyeing 300M+ FDV as 150M Chesscom souls dip into decentralized duels without ditching the soul of strategy. 

If you're ghosting the daily puzzles, yapping for those top-500 yapper rewards, or farming Ethernals vibes instead of diving in, snap out of it before Oct 25th seals the fate

I'm calling 5x post-TGE on pure adoption fire. Who's conjuring their opening gambit with me tonight? gChess $CHECK
